nodes.summary: The spectral condition number `λ_max / λ_min` of a positive definite matrix. For `n = 0` it is `0 / 0 = 0` (no eigenvalues), a junk value; the bound below is stated for `0 < n`.
nodes.title: Spectral condition number of a positive definite matrix

nodes.summary: For the solution `x⋆` of `A x⋆ = b`, `‖x_k - x⋆‖_A ≤ ‖x₀ + z - x⋆‖_A` for every `z ∈ 𝒦_k(A, r₀)`.
nodes.title: CG minimizes the energy norm of the error over the Krylov space

nodes.summary: The conjugate gradient error bound in terms of the condition number `κ` of `A`: `‖x_k - x⋆‖_A ≤ 2 ((√κ - 1) / (√κ + 1))^k ‖x₀ - x⋆‖_A`.
nodes.title: The conjugate gradient error bound in terms of the condition number

nodes.summary: If the eigenvalues of `A` lie in `[a, c]` with `0 < a` and `A x⋆ = b`, the CG iterates satisfy `‖x_k - x⋆‖_A ≤ 2 ((√κ - 1) / (√κ + 1))^k ‖x₀ - x⋆‖_A` with `κ = c / a`.
nodes.title: The conjugate gradient error bound

nodes.summary: If the eigenvalues of `A` lie in `[a, c]` with `0 < a`, and `x` minimizes `‖· - x⋆‖_A` over `x₀ + 𝒦_k(A, A (x⋆ - x₀))`, then `‖x - x⋆‖_A ≤ 2 ((√κ - 1) / (√κ + 1))^k ‖x₀ - x⋆‖_A` with `κ = c / a`.
nodes.title: The Chebyshev bound for Krylov energy minimizers

nodes.summary: The energy norm `‖v‖_A = √(vᵀ A v)`; a norm when `A` is positive definite.
nodes.title: Energy norm induced by a matrix

nodes.summary: The initial state `x₀`, `r₀ = d₀ = b - A x₀`.
nodes.title: Initial conjugate gradient state
CG stays in the Krylov space

nodes.summary: The `k`-th conjugate gradient state from `x₀` for the system `A x = b`.
nodes.title: Conjugate gradient state after $k$ steps

nodes.summary: The Krylov space `𝒦_k(A, r) = span {r, A r, …, A^{k-1} r}`.
nodes.title: Krylov subspace

nodes.summary: The state of the conjugate gradient method: iterate `x`, residual `r = b - A x` and search direction `d`.
nodes.title: State of the conjugate gradient method

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
